items.title: Merge Plugins, Update Collection, and Rules Generator can't see Workshop-authored collections at all (root cause found)
items.why: scanStagingCollections excludes every vortex_collection_*-named folder unconditionally, regardless of whether it has real collection.json content -- confirmed live via ed97e13's own testing (fetching a collection changed nothing in Merge Plugins' list). Shared by 3 tools; needs a real content-check, not just deleting the exclusion (which exists on purpose, to hide empty drafts).
items.prompt:
Root cause found and confirmed live (see ed97e13's own handoff -- this item exists because that task's original premise turned out to be false, not from a fresh report).

THE BUG: `lib/vortex-sync/lib.js`'s `scanStagingCollections` -- the shared primitive behind `listInstalledCollections`, used by Merge Plugins, Update Collection, AND Rules Generator -- excludes every `vortex_collection_*`-named folder unconditionally, BEFORE it ever checks whether a real `collection.json` exists there:
```js
if (/^vortex_collection_/i.test(entry.name)) continue;
```
Confirmed live: fetched a real never-downloaded Workshop collection ("My Spaghetti Mods") via the existing Fetch-from-Nexus action -- `collection.json` genuinely exists on disk afterward, 20 mods -- and Merge Plugins' own collection list was UNCHANGED, still exactly 8 entries, before and after.

WHY THE EXCLUSION EXISTS (don't just delete it -- read this first): that function's own comment, confirmed real 2026-07-24 against 29 real Workshop-tab entries, explains this filter exists specifically so Workshop drafts-in-progress (no real content yet, still being authored) never show up as "real collections" in Merge Plugins/Update Collection/Rules Generator. A naive "also include it if collection.json exists" fix risks surfacing genuinely-empty or barely-started drafts in all three tools -- exactly what this exclusion was written to prevent.

SCOPE: figure out the RIGHT condition to distinguish "a Workshop-authored collection that's actually been fetched/extracted and has real content" from "a bare draft with nothing real in it yet" -- likely something richer than just collection.json presence (e.g. collection.json exists AND has a non-trivial mod count AND/OR real per-mod staging subfolders actually exist under it, not just the top-level metadata file). Check what each of the three callers (Merge Plugins, Update Collection, Rules Generator) actually assumes/needs from a "real installed collection" before relaxing the filter for all three at once -- they may not all need identical treatment.

Also correct `web/public/index.html`'s Merge Plugins callout ("Not seeing a Workshop-authored collection here?") once this actually works -- it currently says this is a known gap being worked on; update it back to real, working guidance once fixed.

VERIFY live: re-run the exact repro from ed97e13's handoff (a real never-downloaded Workshop collection, fetched via the existing action, real content extracted via Rebuild Missing Files or Rebuild Collection afterward) and confirm it NOW appears in Merge Plugins/Update Collection/Rules Generator once it has real content -- and confirm a genuinely bare, unfetched draft still correctly does NOT appear (the original exclusion's own purpose). Handoff with real before/after collection counts for all three tools, not just Merge Plugins.
